response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) as avg_feerate FROM fees f WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), channel_stats AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) as channel_avg FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase) SELECT AVG(cs.channel_avg) as mean_feerate_above_avg, AVG(cs.channel_avg - oa.avg_feerate) as avg_distance_above FROM channel_stats cs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE cs.channel_avg > oa.avg_feerate
